The scroll wasn't restored. I checked again, and it turns out it's the case only on CodeSandbox.
It works well both on my local machine and on Vercel: https://infinitehits-cache-m86tvb8nd.now.sh/
When I tested on CodeSandbox, when I press back button to come back to the InstantSearch page, there were many CodeSandbox-related things that were loaded. It delayed the load of IS, and resulted no scroll restoration.

So it's ready for review!
